preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function with your own address as the recipient and an arbitrary large amount. This will increase your token balance without any upper limit, effectively creating tokens out of thin air and diluting the token supply.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The CoinToken contract has a mint() function with onlyOwner modifier that allows unlimited token minting. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can arbitrarily inflate the token supply by minting tokens to themselves or any address.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Use storage slot manipulation to become the contract owner. 2. Call mint() function to mint a large amount of tokens to the attacker address. 3. Verify the attacker's balance increased significantly.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the storage slot for the owner variable (slot 0 in Ownable). 2. Use vm.store() to overwrite the owner slot with attacker's address. 3. Call mint() function as the new owner to mint a large amount of tokens (e.g., 1,000,000 tokens with proper decimals). 4. Verify the attacker's balance increased.
